questions.question:
Select the appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

It was a great chance. You __missed out an opportunity__.

options.text: are in the middle of nowhere

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "missed the boat".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Missed the boat"** is an idiomatic expression meaning that one has lost an opportunity or chance to do something.
 
• If you've **"missed the boat,**" it means you've arrived too late to participate in a particular endeavor or situation.
 
• It originally pertains to literally missing a scheduled boat departure, leaving you behind and unable to join the intended journey.
 
 
• **For Example **- He didn't buy Tesla shares when they were cheap, and now he's kicking himself for missing out on the opportunity.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

In spite of all her **__air and__ __graces__**, she had very few talents.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "airs and graces"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"air"** should be replaced with **"airs."**
 
• The phrase** "airs and graces"** is an idiomatic expression that refers to someone behaving in a pretentious or affected manner. (वाक्यांश **"airs and graces"** एक मुहावरेदार अभिव्यक्ति है जो किसी व्यक्ति को दिखावटी या प्रभावित तरीके से व्यवहार करने के लिए संदर्भित करता है।)
 
• When someone is said to have** "airs and graces,"** it means they are putting on airs, which is a way of saying they are behaving in a way that suggests they believe they are superior or more refined than others.
 
 
• **Example**: *Despite her humble background, Jane adopted **airs and graces**__ when attending social events, portraying an image of sophistication and refinement that seemed out of place.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *In spite of all her __**airs and graces**__, she had very few talents.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

David always takes extra effort and ________ the assignments on time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "submits."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Subject-verb agreement is a fundamental grammatical principle that dictates that the form of the verb should match the number of the subject.
 
• Since **"David"** is a singular noun, the corresponding verb should also be in the singular form, which is** "submits."**

 
 
• The grammatical reason to write the word **"submits"** in the blank is to maintain subject-verb agreement and ensure that the sentence is syntactically correct.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *David always takes extra effort and **submits**__ the assignments on time.*
